title: Queries hang or fail with 'Unable to start a transaction in the given time' after moving Prisma to driver adapters
symptoms: Transaction API error: Unable to start a transaction in the given time.
Requests wait forever under load instead of failing with a pool timeout
connection_limit and pool_timeout in the URL no longer shape the pool
cause: With driver adapters the pool belongs to the driver. For pg that means 10 connections, no acquire or connect timeout, and a 10 second idle timeout, where Prisma 6 used CPUs times 2 plus 1 connections with a 10 second acquire and 5 second connect timeout.
fix: Set pool size and timeouts on the adapter explicitly.
affected: Prisma ORM 7.0 and later, and 6.x with the driverAdapters feature
